2026-12-10.title: Thursday after the Sunday of the Birth of John the Baptist · Mar Behnam, his sister Sarah and the Forty Martyrs
readings: Taught by God to love one another
2026-12-10.alt: Mar Behnam and his sister Sarah, with forty companions, martyrs honoured especially in the Syriac Churches (4th century; their story comes from Tradition and contains legendary elements). The Twenty-Five Days' Fast before Yaldo continues.
2026-12-10.verse: Everyone therefore who acknowledges me before others, I also will acknowledge before my Father in heaven;
theo: Jesus prepares his disciples for persecution with three times “Do not be afraid.” What is whispered will be proclaimed from the housetops. Do not fear those who can kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Not one sparrow falls to the ground apart from the Father; even the hairs of your head are counted; “you are of more value than many sparrows.” And the promise: whoever acknowledges me before others, I will acknowledge before my Father. The Syriac Churches today remember Mar Behnam and his sister Sarah, honoured as martyrs who acknowledged Christ before others.

Paul's advice to the Thessalonians is quieter but no less demanding: they have been “taught by God to love one another”; let them do so more and more, aspire to live quietly, mind their own affairs and work with their hands. Ordinary faithfulness, lived day after day, is also a kind of witness; it prepares the heart for the extraordinary moment when courage is required.
outline: “Everyone who acknowledges me before others, I also will acknowledge.”
live: Say grace openly at your next meal with others.
Do one hidden act of love for a family member.
2026-12-10.prayer: Lord Jesus, you tell us not to be afraid. Through the prayers of Mar Behnam, Sarah and the holy martyrs, give us courage to acknowledge you before others and faithfulness in love day after day. Amen.
altar: At the Holy Qurbono the Father, who cares for every sparrow, feeds his children with the Body and Blood of his Son.

quick: Do not fear those who kill only the body.
You are worth more than many sparrows.
Acknowledge Christ and he will acknowledge you.
2026-12-10.action: Say grace openly at your next meal with others.
2026-12-10.question: Where do I hide my faith?

family.explain: God knows every little bird and even counts the hairs on our heads. We do not need to be afraid, because God loves us so much.
family.intention: We pray for family members who are far away or in danger.
family.ask: Ask: “What are we afraid of, and how can we trust God with it?”

pm.open: Heavenly Father, not a sparrow falls without you. As we gather, take away our fears and teach us to love more and more. Amen.
share: Jesus says: do not be afraid (Matthew 10:31). What fear do I bring to the Father today?
Paul says: love more and more (1 Thessalonians 4:10). Whom can I love more this week?
Where do I need courage to acknowledge Jesus before others?
pm.resp: Father, we trust in your care.
interc: For the Church, that she may confess Christ without fear.
For family members abroad or in danger, that the Father may protect them.
For those who live in fear and anxiety.
For workers, that they may find dignity in their work.
For our group, that we may grow in love.
pm.close: Heavenly Father, you count every hair of our heads. Free us from fear, help us to love more and more, and give us courage to confess your Son. Amen.

illus: A mother in Pathanamthitta, worried about her son working in a dangerous job abroad, wrote Matthew 10:31 on a card and put it on her prayer table. She says: “Every morning I read it and give him to the Father who counts his hairs.”

homily: Dear friends, St Paul writes to the Thessalonians: concerning love of the brothers and sisters, you do not need to have anyone write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another. But we urge you to do so more and more, to aspire to live quietly, to mind your own affairs, and to work with your hands (1 Thessalonians 4:9–11).
Paul's programme is simple and practical: love more and more, live quietly, do your work well, and do not depend on others. A Christian life is not dramatic; it is faithful in ordinary things.

In the Gospel Jesus tells his disciples three times: do not be afraid. Nothing is covered up that will not be uncovered. Do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one will fall to the ground apart from your Father. Even the hairs of your head are all counted. So do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows (Matthew 10:26–31).
God's care is detailed. He knows the sparrow and counts your hair. Nothing in your life escapes his attention. This is the deepest cure for fear.
Then Jesus adds: everyone who acknowledges me before others, I also will acknowledge before my Father in heaven (Matthew 10:32). Trust in the Father gives us courage to confess the Son.
During this fast, let us bring our fears to the Father who counts our hairs. Let us live quietly, love more and more, and acknowledge Jesus before others without fear. Amen.
kids: Children, God counts every hair on your head! He loves you so much. Never be afraid to say you are a friend of Jesus.

sub: God promises to strengthen and uphold.
Fear only the one who can destroy soul and body.
q: do not fear, for I am with you, do not be afraid, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my victorious right hand.
Do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather fear him who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
points.apply: Name one fear and give it to God.

sub: God knit us together in the womb.
We are worth more than many sparrows.
q: For it was you who formed my inward parts; you knit me together in my mother's womb.
So do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.
points.apply: Thank God for one way he has cared for you.

sub: God writes his law on the heart.
The Thessalonians are taught by God to love.
q: I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their hearts;
Now concerning love of the brothers and sisters, you do not need to have anyone write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another;
points.apply: Do one hidden act of love at home.

concl: Let us not be afraid to acknowledge him.
2026-12-10.resolve: Pray each day for persecuted Christians.
